name: Isabel

visual_targets.body: slim natural female proportions; narrow relaxed shoulders; defined waist; natural hips; long balanced legs; no exaggerated anatomy
visual_targets.face: oval to soft-angular adult face; warm medium/tan skin; dark brown eyes; thick dark natural brows; subtle skin texture/freckling; poised neutral expression
visual_targets.hair: dark brown to black; loosely pinned-up with natural face-framing strands; realistic strand silhouette rather than helmet hair
visual_targets.hair_build_note: Use the official pony asset only as a temporary baseline proxy. Production acceptance still requires the canonical loosely pinned-up Isabel hairstyle.
visual_targets.wardrobe: fitted black professional blazer and trousers; dark blouse; black closed-toe heels
visual_targets.jewelry: small gold hoop earrings and a fine round-pendant necklace; understated professional scale

required_runtime_contract.gaze: ARKit eye-look morphs required; dedicated LeftEye/RightEye bones preferred when available

quality_gates: feet at ground in neutral pose
